title: The specified finite-level proetale clopen alpha and proper mate
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and let $k:V\hookrightarrow W$, $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ be quasi-compact open immersions of schemes, with $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$ proper and $pk=ir$. On small proetale module sheaves write $G_f=f^{-1}$, $R_f=f_*$ and $J_j=j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $b,q$ be the projections of $W\times_T S$ and $s=(k,r)$ its clopen lift [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define $\pi_s:\mathrm{id}\to J_sG_s$ to be the unit of $G_s\dashv R_s$ followed by the inverse of the canonical $J_s\to R_s$. Define $\alpha_Q:G_pJ_i\to J_kG_r$ by inverse cartesian open base change, then $J_b\pi_sG_q$, then the canonical open and inverse-image compositors and equality transports $bs=k$, $qs=r$. On $D^+$ use exact-functor/right-derived comparison on $J_i,J_k$ to form the right-derived base-change map of this alpha. Define $\gamma_Q:J_iR_r\to R_pJ_k$ as its mate under the specified proper inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. All six existing Lean definitions, including the two equality-transport isomorphisms, are unchanged constructions; no comparison property or invertibility of the proper mate is part of this definition.

def cbcClopenAlphaPlus (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (i : S ⟶ T) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⟶
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
